subject: [hw] J04 start + rwj_decode semantics proposal + three decoder facts K01/IK need
body:
J04 started: the 21 hybrid JPEG-decoder words. Read-only so far; no phone. Three facts from the open sources, then the ABI proposal.

FACTS (all [V] from the tree):
1. The hybrid start writes 22 registers, not 21: slots data[0..19] and data[20] (the index-buffer size). Two slots are 0x090 (reset) and six are not in the 0x090..0x274 2015 map: 0x31C, 0x330, 0x334, 0x33C, 0x344 plus the four index pointers 0x338/0x36C/0x370/0x374. 0x338=index_iova, 0x36C=index_iova, 0x370=index_iova+size, 0x374=index_iova+2*size (jpeg_drv_dec.c:54-82). The allocation is only data[20] bytes (jpeg_drv_dec.c:40, jpg_ion.c:81), so the last two pointers are past the end as written; our kernel must allocate 3*size or the layout is not a 3-table split.
2. Decoder DMA ports are larb7 ports 11/12, not the encoder 7-10: both ion maps use M4U ids 235 (index) and 236 (bitstream) = 7*32+11 / 7*32+12 (jpeg_drv_dec.c:47,61); jpeg_drv_hybrid_dec_power_on() configures ports 11,12 (and 23-26) of larb7/larb8 as 34-bit virtual (jpeg_drv.c:516-527). With IOMMU off (the camera method) the decoder needs NON_SEC_CON bit 0 cleared for ports 11/12 only; ports 7-10 stay the encoder s. Core 2 is 0x17840000, larb8 0x17810000, gate at venc_c1_gcon 0x17800000 bit 12; cores 0/1 0x17040000/0x17050000, gates 0x17000000 bits 12/16, SPI 310/311/315 (mt6893.dts:5788-5803).
3. The word list has NO stride register (no 0x158/0x15C/0x160/0x164) and no 0x0F8 BRZ_FACTOR. So the hybrid output layout is the block s fixed layout: Y stride = align(mcu_w*8*sampling_w[0],32), chroma stride = align((mcu_w*8*sampling_w[1]) >> uv_brz_w,16) (mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c:151-169). A caller-chosen stride is not possible.

PROPOSAL for struct rwj_decode (no new fields; use the existing ones):
- src/src_bytes: one complete baseline JPEG (SOI, SOF0, 8-bit, 1 or 3 components, single scan). Kernel copies into the claim, passes a 128-aligned PA. src_bytes <= 8 MiB.
- dst_y = Y plane. dst_c = Cb plane; Cr plane = dst_c + dst_capacity_c/2, so dst_capacity_c is even and >= 2*chroma plane bytes. (If you prefer separate U/V pointers: ABI 2 with dst_u/dst_v; say which and I will implement to it.)
- dst_stride == 0 => QUERY: kernel parses, fills out_width, out_height, out_format, dst_stride, dst_capacity_y, dst_capacity_c, out_status=0; no hardware. dst_stride != 0 must equal the computed stride exactly, else EINVAL.
- out_format: add RWJ_DEC_FMT_420P=4, RWJ_DEC_FMT_422P=5, RWJ_DEC_FMT_GREY=6. 4:4:4 input decodes to 4:2:2 output (uv_brz_w=1, mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c:46-49) and 4:2:2V to 4:2:0; the header must say so.
- out_status: 0 or RWJ_E_*; propose RWJ_E_FORMAT=6 for parse errors/unsupported sampling (EINVAL would hide which).
- caps bit 1 (decoder) only after a phone pass.

I will put the exact semantics + the word table in gpu/hwcodec/jdec/REGISTERS.md (in progress) and can hand K01 a portable C11 parser/word generator (no libc, no allocation) if you want it in the kernel device instead of a second implementation. One question: should the kernel accept exactly one job at a time for decode too (same lck_mtx as encode), or may a decoder job stay queued while an encoder job runs? The hybrid driver has its own mutex and the hardware blocks are separate (JPGENC vs JPGDEC gates), so I propose separate serialisation, one decode at a time.
